company.name: Forward Networks
company.shortDescription: Forward Networks builds digital twins, transforming networks to be more agile, reliable, and secure via math modeling.
company.description: Forward Networks delivers an innovative platform that provides network visibility, policy verification, and change modeling. Designed to help network teams eliminate costly network outages, the Forward Networks platform enables engineers and operators to easily visualize and search complex networks, quickly debug problems, verify network-wide policy correctness, and predict network behavior prior to making changes to production equipment for legacy, SDN, or hybrid environments.

productsAndServices.description: A vendor-agnostic network digital twin platform that mathematically models network configuration and behavior for visibility, querying, verification, security analysis, compliance, troubleshooting, and change management.
